name: Look AI Ventures

entity_kind.quote: Look AI Ventures is a pre-Series A venture capital fund based in Prague, Czech Republic, investing in early-stage AI startups.

investor_type.quote: Look AI Ventures is a pre-Series A venture capital fund based in Prague, Czech Republic, investing in early-stage AI startups.

sectors.quote: Look AI Ventures fund (LAIV) is the first investment fund in the Czech Republic that focuses exclusively on AI startups worldwide

stages.quote: You are an early-stage startup (pre-Series A)

ticket_max.quote: The targeted investment amount in one start-up is €250,000 and mentorship will be provided.

investments.quote: Look AI Ventures has backed Embodied AI, a Lausanne-based robotics startup building robots that learn new tasks directly on factory production lines.
Look AI Ventures has joined Sodex Innovations' €4M funding round, led by Capmont Technology, to scale its AI-powered construction site surveying platform globally.

Slovak startup Cequence, which helps companies automate contract workflows using artificial intelligence, has successfully raised €2 million in seed funding to accelerate its growth. The round was led by Czech Jet Ventures, with participation from our Look AI Ventures fund

notes: Prague-based AI-only early-stage VC (SICAV), launched Q4 2022 on top of AI Startup Incubator; operations managed by Look AI Investments. Ticket €250K is the 2023 launch target (follow-ons reportedly up to €1M, not verified). Target fund size €20M at launch; final close not found, so AUM omitted.
